spec.legendFormat: Shmem - Total memory used by shared memory (shmem) and tmpfs
Inactive - Memory which has been less recently used.  It is more eligible to be reclaimed for other purposes
Active - Memory that has been used more recently and usually not reclaimed unless absolutely necessary.

spec.title: Disk I/O Merged
spec.description: Reads and writes which are adjacent to each other may be merged for efficiency.  Thus two 4K reads may become one 8K read before it is ultimately handed to the disk, and so it will be counted (and queued) as only one I/O.  This field lets you know how often this was done.

spec.title: Memory - Basic
spec.description: `Available`: An estimate of how much (non-`Free`) memory is available for starting new applications, without swapping.

spec.title: CPU Utilization
spec.description:
* `baseline`: baseline CPU utilization threshold for your Machine type. Your instance can burst above this threshold, but only for short periods.
* `steal`: Percentage of time the virtual CPU was waiting on a CPU in use by other VMs, due to throttling or other CPU contention on the host.

spec.expr:
fly_instance_cpu_baseline{app="$app", instance="$instance"} /
count(fly_instance_cpu{app="$app", instance="$instance", mode="idle"})without(cpu_id, mode) * 100

spec.title: I/O Utilization
spec.description: Proportion of each second spent doing I/Os.

spec.title: Average I/O Duration
spec.description: Total number of seconds spent by all reads/writes divided by the total number of reads/writes completed successfully.

spec.title: Average Queue Depth
spec.description: `disk_time_io_weighted` provides an easy measure of both I/O completion time and the backlog that may be accumulating.

spec.title: Per-CPU Utilization
spec.description:
* `baseline`: baseline CPU utilization threshold for your Machine type. Your instance can burst above this threshold, but only for short periods.
* `steal`: Percentage of time the virtual CPU was waiting on a CPU in use by other VMs, due to throttling or other CPU contention on the host.

spec.expr:

spec.title: CPU Quota Balance and Throttling
spec.description:
Aggregate across all CPUs.
* `baseline`: baseline CPU utilization threshold for your Machine type. Your instance can burst above this threshold, but only for short periods.
* `balance`: Accumulated burst balance in seconds.
* `throttled`: Percentage of time your instance was throttled to its baseline performance.
* `steal`: Percentage of time the instance was waiting on a CPU in use by other VMs, due to throttling or other CPU contention on the host.

spec.expr:
fly_instance_cpu_baseline{app="$app", instance="$instance"} /
count(fly_instance_cpu{app="$app", instance="$instance", mode="idle"})without(cpu_id, mode) * 100

spec.description: total size of vmalloc memory area

spec.title: Memory - Detailed
spec.description:
* `Total`: Total usable ram (i.e. physical ram minus a few reserved bits and the kernel binary code)
* `Available`: An estimate of how much memory is available for starting new applications, without swapping
* `Buffers`: Relatively temporary storage for raw disk blocks - shouldn't get tremendously large (20MB or so)
* `Cached`: in-memory cache for files read from the disk (the pagecache).  Doesn't include `SwapCached`

spec.legendFormat: Total - Total usable ram (i.e. physical ram minus a few reserved bits)
Used - misc memory used by user-space applications
VmallocUsed - amount of vmalloc area which is used
Buffers - Relatively temporary storage for raw disk blocks
Dirty - Memory which is waiting to get written back to the disk
Writeback - Memory which is actively being written back to the disk
Cached - In-memory cache for files read from the disk (the pagecache)
SwapUsed - Memory which has been evicted from RAM, and is temporarily on the disk
SwapCached - Memory that was swapped back in but still also is in the swapfile
SwapTotal - total amount of swap space available

matcher.options: Total - Total usable ram (i.e. physical ram minus a few reserved bits)
